description: A saw-ish oscillator in 4HP, with a control that bends the shape of the wave

params.text: Sets the pitch, -3V to +3V, each volt an octave away from the base note
Chooses the note that 0V gives: A at 440Hz, or C at 261.63Hz
Bends the shape of the wave, changing its timbre and not its pitch

inputs.text: Added to the FREQ knob a volt per octave, the sum held between -3V and +6V
Added to the MOD knob, a third of a unit of shape per volt

outputs.text: The wave, about 5V either side of zero, with any constant offset removed

inputs.0: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
